identifiability_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE_FORMAL: A definition, theorem, or counterexample whose truth is mathematical rather than causally identified from data.
identifiability_vocabulary.DIRECT_INTERVENTIONAL: The target is estimated from controlled interventions with qualifying execution identity.
identifiability_vocabulary.ASSUMPTION_IDENTIFIED: The target is identified from observational data only under an explicit causal model and stated identification assumptions.
identifiability_vocabulary.PARTIALLY_IDENTIFIED: Only a bound or identified set is supported.
identifiability_vocabulary.NOT_IDENTIFIED: Multiple data-compatible causal models give different target values.
identifiability_vocabulary.SIMULATION_ONLY: The relation is evaluated only in a stipulated synthetic model.
identifiability_vocabulary.NOT_IDENTIFIED_NOT_EXECUTED: The proposed empirical target has neither a completed identifying design nor qualifying execution evidence.

global_claim_boundary: No entry establishes empirical causal transfer, cognition, alignment, safety, product performance, canon admission, licensing, disclosure approval, or publication approval. Candidate theorems remain open to independent proof review; empirical hypotheses remain unexecuted.

records.title: Legacy ACBE is not an alias for approximate causal abstraction
records.exact_statement: ACBE_legacy denotes only the registered four-level preorder and designated descent label; ACBE_NT2 denotes a formal marked-context label; ACBE-P5 denotes this publication lane; ACA denotes the new interventional model relation. No pair is type-identical.
assumptions: Registered conservative Noetic Topos source identity E9885F27581626CCF26AC4809F446AB5044BC92C61923B951B7F4686591BAEF8
Noetic Topos 2.0 source boundary remains controlling
records.permitted_wording: Paper 5 introduces ACA as a new typed construct and preserves legacy ACBE separately.
records.prohibited_wording: Legacy ACBE always meant approximate causal abstraction.

records.title: Interventional response profile
records.exact_statement: An interventional response profile is M=(C,X,I,K), where C and X are measurable spaces, I is a typed allowed-intervention set, and K:CxI~>X is a Markov kernel whose index carries independently declared intervention semantics.
assumptions: Measurable spaces and kernel are well defined
Intervention operators are declared independently of the observed conditional law
records.permitted_wording: The profile packages post-intervention response laws.

records.title: Approximate causal-abstraction candidate
records.exact_statement: For low/high profiles, A=(tau,kappa,omega,E,d,mu) contains a measurable state map, measurable context map, partial typed intervention map, preregistered evaluation domain, law discrepancy, and optional design distribution.
assumptions: All maps are well typed
omega is defined on every intervention required by E
E is nonempty
Maps and E are frozen before confirmatory outcome access
records.permitted_wording: A is a proposed comparison object.
records.prohibited_wording: Choosing a representation automatically determines a valid intervention map.

records.title: Interventional commutation defect
records.exact_statement: delta_A(c,i)=d(tau_*K_L(.|c,i),K_H(.|kappa(c),omega(i))). A is epsilon-approximate on E when the supremum of delta_A over E is at most epsilon.
assumptions: The compared laws live on the same high-level measurable space
d and epsilon are fixed before confirmatory outcomes
No invalid or unmappable required evaluation is silently dropped
records.permitted_wording: The defect measures disagreement between two declared intervention-response routes.
records.prohibited_wording: The defect is a universal scalar measure of causality.

records.title: Zero defect is exact commutation on the evaluated domain
records.exact_statement: If d separates probability measures, Delta_infinity(A)=0 if and only if tau_*K_L(.|c,i)=K_H(.|kappa(c),omega(i)) for every (c,i) in E.
assumptions: d is nonnegative and separates probability measures
E is the exact declared evaluation domain
records.status: PROOF SKETCH COMPLETE / INDEPENDENT PROOF REVIEW OPEN
records.permitted_wording: Zero defect gives exact interventional commutation on E.
records.prohibited_wording: Zero sampled defect proves global causal equivalence.

records.title: Total-variation defects compose subadditively
records.exact_statement: For two map-compatible abstraction candidates on a composition-compatible domain, if their total-variation defects are bounded by epsilon_1 and epsilon_2, the composite defect is bounded by epsilon_1+epsilon_2.
assumptions: Total variation is the registered metric
State, context, and intervention maps compose
Evaluation domains and supports are compatible
records.status: PROOF SKETCH COMPLETE / INDEPENDENT PROOF REVIEW OPEN
records.permitted_wording: Compatible TV defects admit an additive upper bound.
records.prohibited_wording: All abstraction metrics compose additively without further conditions.

records.title: Bounded estimands inherit a total-variation error bound
records.exact_statement: For measurable g:X_H->[0,1], the difference of its expectations under the two high-level response routes is at most their total variation; a two-intervention contrast differs by at most twice a uniform epsilon defect.
assumptions: g takes values in [0,1]
Total variation uses the supremum-over-events convention
Both interventions are in E
records.status: PROOF SKETCH COMPLETE / INDEPENDENT PROOF REVIEW OPEN
records.permitted_wording: Given the interventional laws, the registered bounded estimand transfer error is bounded.
records.prohibited_wording: The bound identifies causal effects from observational data.

records.title: Intervention-map collisions force error when mapped responses differ
records.exact_statement: If two low-level interventions have mapped response laws separated by TV distance gamma but omega maps them to one high-level intervention, at least one abstraction defect is at least gamma/2.
assumptions: Both cases share the mapped high-level context
The two interventions are evaluated
Total variation is the registered metric
records.status: PROOF SKETCH COMPLETE / INDEPENDENT PROOF REVIEW OPEN
records.permitted_wording: A many-to-one intervention map has an auditable collision lower bound in this case.
records.prohibited_wording: Every many-to-one intervention map is invalid.

records.title: Observational equivalence with different intervention laws
records.exact_statement: The binary SCMs X:=U,Y:=X and Y:=U,X:=Y with U~Bernoulli(1/2) have the same observational joint law but different Y laws under do(X=0).
assumptions: Standard hard-intervention semantics
U is Bernoulli(1/2)
records.permitted_wording: Observational equality alone does not identify the intervention response.
records.prohibited_wording: Correlation or observational gluing proves the ACA relation.

records.title: Constant-map trivialization
records.exact_statement: A constant state map into a one-state high-level model can achieve zero defect for every low-level model while preserving no state or intervention distinction.
assumptions: The high-level response is constant
All low-level interventions may collide under omega
records.permitted_wording: Low defect requires separate retention and intervention-separation gates.
records.prohibited_wording: Zero defect alone proves a meaningful abstraction.

records.title: Average defect can hide worst-case failure
records.exact_statement: With 99 zero-defect cases and one unit-defect case under uniform weighting, Delta_mu=0.01 while Delta_infinity=1.
assumptions: One hundred equally weighted cases
Defects lie in [0,1]
records.permitted_wording: Mean, tail, worst-case, and case-level results must be reported together.
records.prohibited_wording: A small mean defect guarantees uniformly reliable abstraction.

records.title: Markov composition and sheaf gluing do not entail causal abstraction
records.exact_statement: A stochastic kernel, compatible local distribution family, global extension, naturality square, or low sheaf residual does not establish ACA without independently supplied intervention semantics, maps, and an interventional comparison.
assumptions: Paper 4 type boundary
No hidden intervention semantics is assumed
records.permitted_wording: Paper 4 may organize stochastic evidence that Paper 5 evaluates causally under separate assumptions.
records.prohibited_wording: A Markov or sheaf diagram is already a causal-abstraction theorem.

records.title: Synthetic neural/high-level interchange abstraction
records.exact_statement: For one preregistered open-weight model revision, synthetic algorithmic task, high-level causal program, alignment, and intervention grid, the upper confidence bound on Delta_infinity is below epsilon, coverage and non-vacuity gates pass, and the candidate-control specificity margin exceeds m on confirmatory and held-out joined runs.
assumptions: Exact model, data, mapping, intervention, metric, epsilon, m, power, and control specifications are preregistered
Controlled intervention execution is authentic and semantically faithful
Confirmatory and replication groups are disjoint
Independent numerical replay and claim review complete
